approved: Customs Amendment (Australia-United Kingdom Free Trade Agreement Implementation) Bill 2022
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would change the rules for deciding which goods imported from the United Kingdom qualify for lower customs duties.
It would amend the Customs Act 1901 to set out new rules of origin for goods from the United Kingdom.
The changes would take effect on the later of the bill receiving royal assent and the free trade agreement entering into force.
Introduces new rules of origin for goods imported from the United Kingdom.
Enables goods that satisfy those rules to enter Australia at preferential customs duty rates.
Makes complementary amendments to the Customs Tariff Act 1995.
Importers of goods from the United Kingdom and Australian businesses trading under the free trade agreement.
Customs Amendment (Australia-United Kingdom Free Trade Agreement Implementation) Act 2022
